title: Kasdan Co. — Website
summary: A bright, playful site for our donut and coffee shop, with ordering ahead and a build-your-own-donut tool.
overview: kasdan co. makes small-batch donuts and specialty coffee on Queen St E in Sault Ste. Marie, and at the Soo Mrkt on Saturdays. The website had to feel as fun as the shop and still make the two things customers want — ordering ahead and finding us — effortless.

cover.alt: kasdan co. homepage: the headline Donuts worth waking up for, with Order Ahead and Build Your Own Donut buttons and floating illustrated donuts

idea.heading: The idea
body: Make the website taste like the shop. Soft cream backgrounds, a punchy blue, and illustrated donuts drifting across the screen set the mood before a word is read — then "Donuts worth waking up for" says the rest.
Two buttons lead the page: Order Ahead, for regulars on their way in, and Build Your Own Donut, which turns the menu into something to play with and share.

execution.heading: What we built
body: Design and development, online ordering, an interactive donut builder, menu and location pages, and local SEO so the shop shows up for "donuts in Sault Ste. Marie".
